Name: Tailor Weapon Skins
Author: PeaslyWellbott
Description:
Allows you to reskin weapons at the Sewing Machine just like you do with Boots, by transferring the stats of one weapon onto the appearance of another. Check the item preview to make sure you're going the right way!

Configurable options:
[code]﻿"KeepSkinSourceWeapon" (default true) - if true, the weapon you use for its appearance will not be consumed
"KeepStatSourceWeapon" (default false) - if true, the weapon you use for its stats will not be consumed
[/code]
Compatibility:
[list]
[*]No expected conflicts with mods that alter weapon stats or add new weapons
[*]Possible conflicts with mods that change Tailoring logic (if there are any others)
[*]Interaction with the Forge not yet clear.
[/list]
Uninstallation:
[list]
[*]Any reskinned weapons in your save will remain altered.
[/list]
